intro: Meet Arcadia—the perfect solution for modern homes. Its half-hydraulic storage makes accessing your essentials a breeze, while its stylish headboard design adds elegance to your space​. Plush comfort or firm support - the Restomagic Dual let's you choose. The dual-sided mattress allows for with two firmness levels, so whatever your needs, you wake up rested and ready for the day.

features.title: Neutral design with three-piece foil clad panels
features.text: Intricate deadboard design with three-piece foil clad create a striking focal point that adds instant character to your space.

features.title: Storage that works for you
features.text: Storage made easy. The half hydraulic lift-up mechanism gives you effortless access to under-bed storage, while the half box compartment keeps essentials organised.

features.title: Sturdy metal understructure for enhanced durability
features.text: You deserve furniture that lasts—the sturdy 1.2 mm metal frame provides long-term strength you can count on.

features.title: A finish that stays beautiful
features.text: Built to last—scratch-resistant prelaminated particle board keeps your furniture looking pristine every day.

features.title: Comfort on both sides, your way
features.text: Crave flexibility? Our dual-sided mattress lets you pick between plush comfort and firm support—so your bed adjusts to you.

features.title: Soft quilting adds an extra layer of comfort
features.text: Your bed should welcome you the moment you lie down, and our plush quilted top does exactly that, offering soft, breathable comfort that helps you unwind with ease.

name: Arcadia V2 Queen Size Half Hydraulic Storage Bed And Mattress Combo
